entries.2c0a0bd1a5d6c0e8: This is the reportable segment of the group, operated by five banks: The Bank of Fukuoka, The Kumamoto Bank, The Juhachi-Shinwa Bank, The Fukuoka Chuo Bank and Minna Bank. The five banks operate through their head offices and branches, conducting deposit, lending, domestic exchange and foreign exchange operations, among others. All five banks are consolidated subsidiaries in which the company holds 100% of voting rights (as of March 31, 2026). The head offices of The Bank of Fukuoka, The Fukuoka Chuo Bank and Minna Bank are in Chuo-ku, Fukuoka City; that of The Kumamoto Bank is in Chuo-ku, Kumamoto City; and that of The Juhachi-Shinwa Bank is in Nagasaki City. The Bank of Fukuoka and The Juhachi-Shinwa Bank each account for more than 10% of consolidated ordinary income. Because ordinary income from external customers in the banking business exceeds 90% of consolidated ordinary income, amounts by service are not disclosed.
entries.3037fcbf770c947b: Business Revitalization Support and Debt Collection Business
entries.9684feb9c28d4182: A bank holding company that owns The Bank of Fukuoka, The Kumamoto Bank, Juhachi-Shinwa Bank, Fukuoka Chuo Bank and Minna no Ginko, and provides financial services mainly in Kyushu.
entries.f12b30a2bed6f7bd: This is a category that combines businesses other than banking, in which the company and its affiliates engage in securities, guarantee, business revitalization support and debt collection, leasing and other businesses. Principal companies are FFG Securities (securities business), Fukugin Guarantee (debt guarantee business), Fukuoka Credit Collection (debt collection business), FFG Card (credit card business), FFG Investment Trust (investment trust management business), and FFG Insurance Service (insurance solicitation business). All of these are consolidated subsidiaries in which the company holds 100% of voting rights, directly or through subsidiaries. FFG Lease, which handles leasing, is an equity-method affiliate in which the company holds 50% of voting rights. Amounts are not disclosed for businesses other than banking because their materiality is low. For this reason, this business, for which no amount is printed, is placed after the banking business (this does not mean zero).
